title: Trade log
dek: The Heavy Reading trade book: the ledger, the discussion log, settlement marks, the scoreboard, and the feedback loop.

claims.text: Trade book opened October 12, 2026 with five trades: four active (short December TMW; long December TMR twice, on the grade flip and on switching economics; long synthetic crude into year-end) and one stood down (TMW-TMS reversion, shadow-marked at 36 lots per side).
Open risk at booking: about $577,000, about 2.3R (1R = $250,000) against a 2R complex budget; the resolution (drop the switching trade or trim the TMW short) is pending and booked in the log.
All booked trades mark flat at inception levels: entry references are the October 9, 2026 ICE settles and the October 12, 2026 settlements file carries the same settles at zero volume.
